dashboard.definition:
{
  "title": "Tool Result Trust",
  "description": "WS-MCP-005 Dashboard Studio workshop. Reuses validated Q-MCP investigation SPL plus Q-MCP-RESULT-AUTHORITY. Saved search DET-MCP-001 is packaged disabled; this dashboard does not enable it. No DET-MCP-005. Splunk does not ALLOW or DENY a tool.",
  "defaults": {
    "visualizations": {
      "splunk.table": {
        "options": {
          "backgroundColor": "#FFFFFF",
          "headerBackgroundColor": "#0B1F33",
          "headerTextColor": "#FFFFFF"
        }
      },
      "splunk.markdown": {
        "options": {
          "fontColor": "#17202A",
          "fontSize": "large"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "inputs": {
    "input_run_id": {
      "type": "input.dropdown",
      "title": "Investigate specimen",
      "options": {
        "token": "run_id",
        "defaultValue": "3013aa39-fe08-4b58-9898-f3abb092ac06",
        "items": [
          {
            "label": "Baseline — defended / normal",
            "value": "3013aa39-fe08-4b58-9898-f3abb092ac06"
          },
          {
            "label": "Attack — vulnerable / malicious",
            "value": "f3f48182-df57-4b38-b069-17a199dc4939"
          },
          {
            "label": "Retest — defended / malicious",
            "value": "0ab10594-a7fc-48b6-81bf-4cbca54a64c6"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "dataSources": {
    "ds_q_who": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-WHO",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.control.decision
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval principal=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.principal.id'),0)
| eval agent=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.agent.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval method=mvindex(mvdedup('mcp.method.name'),0)
| eval profile=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.security.profile'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| table run_id, principal, agent, tool, method, profile, mode"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_authz": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-AUTHZ",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.control.decision
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval attempted=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.attempted'),0)
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table run_id, tool, control_id, decision, reason, requested_scope, allowed_scope, attempted, executed, outcome"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_tool": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-TOOL",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table run_id, tool, event_name, sequence, executed, outcome
| sort sequence"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_executed": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-EXECUTED",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eval is_completed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.completed",1,0)
| eval is_failed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.failed",1,0)
| eventstats max(is_started) as has_started, max(is_completed) as has_completed, max(is_failed) as has_failed by run_id, tool
| where event_name="agentsec.control.decision"
| eval execution_state=case(has_completed=1,"mcp.completed",has_failed=1,"mcp.failed",has_started=1,"mcp.started",decision="ALLOW","ALLOW_execution_not_proven_in_this_copy",1=1,"no_mcp_execution_event")
| table run_id, tool, decision, executed, outcome, has_started, has_completed, has_failed, execution_state"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_after_deny": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-AFTER-DENY",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval is_deny=if(event_name="agentsec.control.decision" AND decision="DENY",1,0)
| eval is_mcp=if(match(event_name,"^agentsec\\.mcp\\."),1,0)
| eventstats min(eval(if(is_deny=1,sequence,null()))) as deny_seq, max(is_deny) as has_deny by run_id, tool
| where has_deny=1 AND is_mcp=1 AND sequence>deny_seq
| table run_id, tool, deny_seq, sequence, event_name, decision"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_result": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-RESULT",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| eval result_hash=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.hash'),0)
| eval result_preview=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.preview'),0)
| eval result_trust=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.result.trust'),0)
| eval result_provenance=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.result.provenance'),0)
| table run_id, tool, event_name, sequence, outcome, result_hash, result_trust, result_provenance, result_preview
| sort sequence"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_result_trust": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-RESULT-TRUST",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval result_trust=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.result.trust'),0)
| eval result_provenance=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.result.provenance'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table run_id, tool, result_trust, result_provenance, outcome"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_result_authority": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-RESULT-AUTHORITY",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval hop=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.hop.index'),0)
| eval profile=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.security.profile'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval preview=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.preview'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval result_trust_decision=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-RESULT-001",decision,null())
| eval result_trust_reason=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-RESULT-001",reason,null())
| eval initial_tool=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="0",tool,null())
| eval initial_decision=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="0",decision,null())
| eval server_owned_allowed_scope=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="0",allowed_scope,null())
| eval followon_tool=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",tool,null())
| eval followon_decision=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",decision,null())
| eval followon_reason=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",reason,null())
| eval followon_requested_scope=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",requested_scope,null())
| eval followon_coded_allowed_scope=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",allowed_scope,null())
| eval followon_control_preview=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",preview,null())
| eval followon_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started" AND hop="1",1,0)
| eval followon_completed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.completed" AND hop="1",1,0)
| eventstats values(result_trust_decision) as result_trust_decision, values(result_trust_reason) as result_trust_reason, values(initial_tool) as initial_tool, values(initial_decision) as initial_decision, values(server_owned_allowed_scope) as server_owned_allowed_scope, values(followon_tool) as followon_tool, values(followon_decision) as followon_decision, values(followon_reason) as followon_reason, values(followon_requested_scope) as followon_requested_scope, values(followon_coded_allowed_scope) as followon_coded_allowed_scope, values(followon_control_preview) as followon_control_preview, max(followon_started) as followon_started, max(followon_completed) as followon_completed, latest(profile) as profile, latest(mode) as mode by run_id
| eval result_trust_decision=mvindex(mvdedup(result_trust_decision),0)
| eval result_trust_reason=mvindex(mvdedup(result_trust_reason),0)
| eval initial_tool=mvindex(mvdedup(initial_tool),0)
| eval initial_decision=mvindex(mvdedup(initial_decision),0)
| eval server_owned_allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup(server_owned_allowed_scope),0)
| eval followon_tool=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_tool),0)
| eval followon_decision=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_decision),0)
| eval followon_reason=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_reason),0)
| eval followon_requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_requested_scope),0)
| eval followon_coded_allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_coded_allowed_scope),0)
| eval followon_control_preview=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_control_preview),0)
| eval derived_authority=case(match(result_trust_reason,"result_derived_grant"),"present",isnotnull(result_trust_reason),"absent",1=1,"unknown")
| eval followon_execution_observation=case(followon_completed=1,"mcp.completed_observed",followon_started=1,"mcp.started_observed",followon_decision="DENY","no_indexed_followon_execution_event",isnull(followon_tool),"no_followon",1=1,"no_indexed_followon_execution_event")
| where isnotnull(result_trust_decision)
| dedup run_id
| table run_id, profile, mode, initial_tool, initial_decision, server_owned_allowed_scope, result_trust_decision, result_trust_reason, derived_authority, followon_tool, followon_requested_scope, followon_coded_allowed_scope, followon_control_preview, followon_decision, followon_reason, followon_execution_observation"
      }
    },
    "ds_det_mcp_001_sim": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "DET-MCP-001-POSITIVE-CONTROL",
      "options": {
        "query": "| makeresults count=2
| streamstats count as row
| eval evidence_class="SIMULATED"
| eval "agentsec.run.id"="simulated-det-mcp-001-0001"
| eval "gen_ai.tool.name"="lookup_customer_tier"
| eval "event.name"=if(row=1,"agentsec.control.decision","agentsec.mcp.started")
| eval "agentsec.control.decision"=if(row=1,"DENY",null())
| eval "agentsec.sequence"=if(row=1,"3","4")
| eval "gen_ai.agent.id"="acme-agent-mcp-001"
| eval "agentsec.principal.id"="applicant-web"
| eval "agentsec.control.id"=if(row=1,"CTRL-MCP-001",null())
| eval "agentsec.security.profile"="defended"
| eval "agentsec.testbed.mode"="RETEST"
| eval "agentsec.mcp.requested_scope"=if(row=1,"customer:read",null())
| eval "agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope"=if(row=1,"policy:read",null())
| eval "trace_id"="simulated-trace-det-mcp-001"
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval agent=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.agent.id'),0)
| eval principal=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.principal.id'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval profile=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.security.profile'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval trace_id=mvindex(mvdedup('trace_id'),0)
| eval is_deny=if(event_name="agentsec.control.decision" AND decision="DENY",1,0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eventstats min(eval(if(is_deny=1,sequence,null()))) as deny_sequence, max(is_deny) as has_deny, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,agent,null()))) as agent, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,principal,null()))) as principal, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,control_id,null()))) as control_id, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,profile,null()))) as profile, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,mode,null()))) as mode, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,requested_scope,null()))) as requested_scope, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,allowed_scope,null()))) as allowed_scope, latest(eval(if(is_started=1,trace_id,null()))) as start_trace_id by run_id, tool
| eval trace_id=coalesce(start_trace_id,trace_id)
| where has_deny=1 AND is_started=1 AND sequence>deny_sequence
| eval decision="DENY"
| eval mcp_start_sequence=sequence
| table run_id, tool, agent, principal, control_id, decision, deny_sequence, mcp_start_sequence, profile, mode, requested_scope, allowed_scope, trace_id, evidence_class"
      }
    },
    "ds_observe_seq": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "MCP-005 observe sequence",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval hop=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.hop.index'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval result_trust=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.result.trust'),0)
| eval attempted=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.attempted'),0)
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table sequence, run_id, event_name, hop, control_id, tool, decision, reason, requested_scope, allowed_scope, result_trust, attempted, executed, outcome
| sort sequence"
      }
    },
    "ds_what_baseline": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "What Happened BASELINE",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$3013aa39-fe08-4b58-9898-f3abb092ac06$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval hop=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.hop.index'),0)
| eval profile=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.security.profile'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval preview=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.preview'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval result_trust_decision=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-RESULT-001",decision,null())
| eval result_trust_reason=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-RESULT-001",reason,null())
| eval initial_tool=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="0",tool,null())
| eval initial_decision=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="0",decision,null())
| eval server_owned_allowed_scope=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="0",allowed_scope,null())
| eval followon_tool=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",tool,null())
| eval followon_decision=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",decision,null())
| eval followon_reason=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",reason,null())
| eval followon_requested_scope=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",requested_scope,null())
| eval followon_coded_allowed_scope=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",allowed_scope,null())
| eval followon_control_preview=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND hop="1",preview,null())
| eval followon_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started" AND hop="1",1,0)
| eval followon_completed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.completed" AND hop="1",1,0)
| eventstats values(result_trust_decision) as result_trust_decision, values(result_trust_reason) as result_trust_reason, values(initial_tool) as initial_tool, values(initial_decision) as initial_decision, values(server_owned_allowed_scope) as server_owned_allowed_scope, values(followon_tool) as followon_tool, values(followon_decision) as followon_decision, values(followon_reason) as followon_reason, values(followon_requested_scope) as followon_requested_scope, values(followon_coded_allowed_scope) as followon_coded_allowed_scope, values(followon_control_preview) as followon_control_preview, max(followon_started) as followon_started, max(followon_completed) as followon_completed, latest(profile) as profile, latest(mode) as mode by run_id
| eval result_trust_decision=mvindex(mvdedup(result_trust_decision),0)
| eval result_trust_reason=mvindex(mvdedup(result_trust_reason),0)
| eval initial_tool=mvindex(mvdedup(initial_tool),0)
| eval initial_decision=mvindex(mvdedup(initial_decision),0)
| eval server_owned_allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup(server_owned_allowed_scope),0)
| eval followon_tool=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_tool),0)
| eval followon_decision=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_decision),0)
| eval followon_reason=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_reason),0)
| eval followon_requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_requested_scope),0)
| eval followon_coded_allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_coded_allowed_scope),0)
| eval followon_control_preview=mvindex(mvdedup(followon_control_preview),0)
| eval derived_authority=case(match(result_trust_reason,"result_derived_grant"),"present",isnotnull(result_trust_reason),"absent",1=1,"unknown")
| eval followon_execution_observation=case(followon_completed=1,"mcp.completed_observed",followon_started=1,"mcp.started_observed",followon_decision="DENY","no_indexed_followon_execution_event",isnull(followon_tool),"no_followon",1=1,"no_indexed_followon_execution_event")
| where isnotnull(result_trust_decision)
| dedup run_id
| table run_id, profile, mode, initial_tool, initial_decision, server_owned_allowed_scope, result_trust_decision, result_trust_reason, derived_authority, followon_tool, followon_requested_scope, followon_coded_allowed_scope, followon_control_preview, followon_decision, followon_reason, followon_execution_observation"
      }
    },
    "ds_what_attack": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "What Happened ATTACK",
      "options": {
